format: UCWDC competitor conduct and registration data (future UCWDC body profile)

source.quote_free_summary: Competitors are expected to follow the UCWDC Associate Membership Code of Conduct and, on any registration form, must give full name, mailing address, birthdate, phone number, e-mail address and UCWDC Associate Membership number.

requirement: A future UCWDC profile would need this data. Collecting it is a FUTURE PRIVACY-DESIGN decision: current data collection is not expanded, and OD-02's under-18 restriction is not relaxed by it. DanceFlow does not administer or verify the Code of Conduct.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED.  DanceFlow does not verify or fulfill it; it remains the organizer's responsibility (R-14) unless DanceFlow explicitly implements and verifies it in a future body profile. It must not block eligible Studio/Custom competitions.
interpretation_notes: Re-read 2026-11-24: 'required to provide their full name, mailing address, birthdate, phone number (cell preferred), e-mail address, and UCWDC Associate Membership number'. Needs a privacy review (data minimisation, retention, consent) before any design.
